title: Projects

empty.title: Welcome to Lab Brain
empty.description: Record your experiments, import your spreadsheets, attach instrument files and let the app work out the numbers. Start with a project: it holds the experiments of one line of work.
empty.rawFiles: Or analyse raw files without a project:

project.title: Create a project
project.text: One line of work, such as a paper or a thesis chapter. It holds everything below.

experiment.title: Add an experiment
experiment.text: One kind of sample with its own columns and codes, like one sheet of a spreadsheet.

samples.title: Record samples
samples.text: One row each: values, notes and measurement files. Then plot, compare and export.
